district: Los Rios Community College District School Facilities Improvement District No. 1
summary: A Yes vote authorizes Los Rios Community College District School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 to issue $1,100,000,000 in bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $16.55 per $100,000 of assessed value, for job training and higher-education facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes new debt and a property-tax levy to fund district facilities, preventing an expected reduction in bond taxes.
tax.quote: Measure H would authorize new debt and a new property-tax levy.

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes up to $1.1 billion in bonds for Los Rios Community College District facilities.
schools.quote: Without a clearer explanation from Los Rios, an otherwise viable facilities measure could be vulnerable to defeat because of how it was presented rather than solely because of what it would fund.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the new debt or levy, and existing bond taxes are expected to decline as older bonds are repaid.
tax.quote: Measure H would authorize new debt and a new property-tax levy.

schools.text: A No vote does not authorize the new Measure H bonds for Los Rios Community College District facilities.
schools.quote: Without a clearer explanation from Los Rios, an otherwise viable facilities measure could be vulnerable to defeat because of how it was presented rather than solely because of what it would fund.
